scoring_settings._comment_offense: 25 yds/pt = 0.04, 10 yds/pt = 0.1. No 'rec' key = standard (non-PPR), matching the table (no Receptions row).
scoring_settings._comment_kickers: Field goals made, by distance bucket. Sleeper does not break out missed FGs by distance for scoring purposes.
scoring_settings._comment_dst: Defense/Special Teams. pts_allow_* are pre-bucketed flags Sleeper provides (1 if that bracket applies that week, else 0), so they work as plain weights just like everything else.

notifications._comment: Do NOT put a real bot token here. Set TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN and TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID as GitHub repo secrets instead -- see README.md.

roster_management._comment: Set enabled true once Yahoo OAuth is set up (see README.md). Only suggests adds into an already-open bench/IR spot -- never suggests a drop.

check_interval_notes: Actual check frequency is controlled by the GitHub Actions cron schedule, not this file. See .github/workflows/fantasy_alerts.yml
